info.title: Gecko Security API
info.description: Programmatic access to scans, vulnerabilities, repositories, schedules, webhooks, and scanner image releases. Authenticate with an API key via the `X-API-Key` header or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

channel.description: Release channel name. Channel names are shared privately by your Gecko account contact and are not listed publicly.

get.summary: Get the API spec discovered by a scan

get.description: Current GitLab connection state for the team, including the stored token expiry date. Never returns credentials.

patch.description: Validates the token against the GitLab instance (including the required "api" scope) before storing it. Omit `instance_url` to keep the currently connected instance.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Safely retry a POST/PATCH; a replayed key returns the original response.

get.summary: List image releases for a channel
get.description: Newest-first history of published scanner images. Pin pulls to the returned digest-pinned `image_ref`, never a mutable tag. Unknown channel names return `not_found`.

schema.description: Release channel name. Channel names are shared privately by your Gecko account contact and are not listed publicly.

get.summary: Get the latest image release for a channel

schema.description: Release channel name. Channel names are shared privately by your Gecko account contact and are not listed publicly.

get.summary: Resolve a version to its image release
get.description: Looks up one release by version within a channel. The path version matches either the customer release version (for example `1.1`) or the Gecko scanner version (for example `1.1.0`). When the same scanner version was pushed more than once, the newest release is returned. Pull the digest-pinned `image_ref`, never a mutable tag. Unknown channels and unknown versions return `not_found`.
